title: Pianist Alma Mundy, Lollipop and comedians
summary: Williams talks about pianist Alma Mundy, who played with him and Howard and now leads a white band, her boyfriend the female-impersonator comedian Lollipop, and the comedian Memphis Lewis.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
